wholePhysicalScope: Pakistan’s Tomb of Baba Farid record 9694 locates the specific monument. The measured 5.2 m square chamber and documented east and south door bearings provide its plan. OpenStreetMap way 174504957 corroborates the wider precinct.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the documented square chamber, pointed dome and long pinnacle, both door openings and the estimated floor. Near levels add doorwork and restrained masonry joints.
limitations: The national monument locator has no stated accuracy. The 5.20 m square is reconstructed from the written survey at that pin. There is no separate digitized tomb perimeter in this mapping.

Dome height and profile, plinth height, thresholds, door widths, trim and metal finishes are estimates. The floor sits just above the highest corner of the unchanged terrain field. The model uses a plain inscription panel to represent the reported location without inventing lettering.
This model covers the tomb chamber and its gates. The neighbouring Ala-ud-Din mausoleum and modern mosque are separate buildings.
The unmodified composite DEM is a terrain reference. Fine historic paving, building decks and abrupt grades are below its resolving power.
